pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-06-19. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-06-19 at 2,094.44 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 6.50 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 1,639 million. The top gainer of the week was Safari Retail (SYN).

Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products.
